projectDescription: A collection of beginner Java exercises and SQL introductory work from a Grade 10 IT Term 1 course, covering variables, data types, math operations, GUI dialogs, and basic database concepts.
keyFeatures: 20+ self-contained Java mini-projects organised by topic
Covers variables, data types, escape sequences, arithmetic, and type casting
Math class usage: pow, sqrt, cbrt, round, abs, max, min
Introductory Swing form design with LoginUI
Term assessment exercises with worked examples
Introductory database work with a Microsoft Access file
Both NetBeans/Ant and Maven build configurations
publicApiSurface: Aftermath.main — circle area via random radius using Math.PI and Math.pow
Armathgeddon.main — square roots, cube roots, and random 4-digit PIN
ChangeIsGood.main — type conversion between String, int, double, char, boolean
CharacterBuilding.main — character literals and numeric character values
DataTypes.main — primitive/reference data types and formatted output
DiceRoller.main — two-dice simulation using Math.random()
EscapeSequences.main — escape sequences and console formatting
FullCircle.main — circle area from user-entered radius
HighsAndLows.main — Math.max and Math.min comparison
IveGotThePower.main — exponentiation with Math.pow
JavaMaths.main — basic arithmetic, integer division, and modulus
LoginCheck.main — dialog-based login validation
LoginUI — Swing form login interface
MessageDialogs.main — JOptionPane message dialog examples
NobodyPutsPythagorusInACorner.main — Pythagorean theorem hypotenuse
RandomGenerator.main — raw Math.random() output
RandomPractice.main — Math.random() scaled to different ranges
RealAltitude.main — Math.abs for altitude distance from sea level
SeeYouRound.main — rounding and VAT calculation
SomethingRandom.main — loops and phone-number-style random output
UserInput_.main — JOptionPane input with booking confirmation
Glasby_Nathan_JavaTest1.main — practical test: output, variables, user input, arithmetic
Glasby_Nathan_Term1.main — term assessment: variables, totals, formatted output
Glasby_Nathan_Term1_v2.main — term assessment: dialogs, age calc, division, charAt
